question: Does a task-specific acquisition metric improve fixed-budget control transfer beyond strong experimental-design baselines, and how does Hamiltonian structure interact with it?
novelty_gate: Generic task-aware optimal design is established; spectral_A is a classical weighted-design adaptation, not a cleared new algorithm
candidate_distribution: Unlabelled uniform configurations on the torus; query any candidate once without replacement; no reachability cost modeled
oracle_rule: Only selected candidates receive true force labels; keyed Gaussian noise shared across methods/families at the same candidate; unselected labels are never computed
model_rule: Fixed zero-mean isotropic Gaussian prior in population-force-whitened coefficients; common precision per coefficient; no validation or test tuning
posterior_covariance: sigma^2*(rho*I+sum B(q)^T B(q))^-1; Bayesian uncertainty, not a bias-inclusive frequentist error guarantee
global_A: Greedy reduction of integrated force posterior variance; A-optimal after force-metric whitening
uncertainty: Maximum current pointwise force posterior variance
occupancy_A: Weighted A-design using desired flow q(t)=q0+target*t from eight pilot phases, t in [0,20]; metric frozen before added labels
spectral_A: Weighted A-design with force-mode tracking weights 1/(gain^2+(k dot target)^2), DC 1/gain^2; metric normalized but argmax unchanged
test_initial_momentum: Task target exactly; independent uniform torus phases; held-out momentum energies exceed pilot energies
primary_metric: Mean per-phase momentum vector RMS over final 100 evaluation states
strict_success: Momentum error below 0.25 at every final 100 states

primary_gate.comparator: Best mean among the four baselines separately in each plant/task cell
primary_gate.interpretation: Practical descriptive screen, not a statistical significance test; no best-candidate selection

confirmation: Only if the primary numerical gate passes: MPC on random/global_A/spectral_A Hamiltonian models at budget64, both plants/tasks and all five world seeds; no controller tuning
stop_rule: If the gate fails, stop this new-algorithm route; retain every result and proceed to comparative-study validation/manuscript consolidation. No extra tuned acquisition variants within Phase7
RL_scope: Prior SAC results remain the RL optimization anchor; no new SAC training unless a separate later protocol is justified. Acquisition and control are tested before reintroducing SAC optimization noise
statistics: Paired pilot/candidate/noise/test phases; five world seeds; report descriptive seed variation and all cells; no IID-phase p-values
animation_case: Misspecified plant, Hamiltonian family, world seed20, forward task, fixed test phase0, budgets16/64; no outcome-selected case
